name: FAA Floppy Panic
hook: Keep the 1982 air traffic server alive before the 5.25-inch disk melts
tagline: Guide a glowing green CRT radar terminal as stacked flight blips swarm the airspace and cooling fans scream. Cash out to clear the runway and land your private jet in the nick of time. Crash and the dusty beige mainframe blows a capacitor, grounding every plane in the nation into a comical holding pattern.
